definition.content:
## Cyberhaven DLP / Insider-Risk Incidents
*Triage and resolution at a glance*

This dashboard provides complete visibility into DLP / insider-risk incidents raised by Cyberhaven policies: severity, sensitivity, blocked vs allowed actions, resolution and underlying event detail.

Data source: Cyberhaven Incident streaming destination (`source:cyberhaven cyberhaven.logtype:cyberhaven-incidents`).

**Tips**
- Use the filters at the top (Policy-Severity, Status, Dataset-Sensitivity, Affected-User, Policy-Name, Dataset-Name, Host, Action-Kind, Blocked-Allowed, Cyberhaven-Tenant) to narrow every panel.
- Use the timeframe selector in the upper-right corner to change the default timeframe.
- Clone this dashboard to rearrange, modify, and add widgets.
High-level view of DLP / insider-risk incidents: totals, open vs closed, blocked, users affected and risk score, plus trends over time.
